text: pi-gui is the strongest dedicated native desktop GUI wrapper for the official Pi coding-agent SDK among evaluated OSS projects
PI WEB is the best fit when sessions must persist server-side and be supervised from multiple devices
Pi Desktop offers the broadest desktop feature surface including Windows installers and optional multi-agent council planning
Pi Code Gui is the leading VS Code-native Pi GUI with editor bridge tools
OpenClaw is Pi-runtime-adjacent but messaging-first and not a dedicated Pi coding GUI
